entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: %s is not a histogram-valued-producing call
entries.rationale: histogramValuedProducerCall (cerberus issue #2618) admits only info(), sort_by_label() and sort_by_label_desc() before returning ok=true, so lowerHistogramValuedProducerCall's switch default arm — reached only when call.Func.Name matches none of those three names — is unreachable for any call this recognizer actually matched, mirroring labelCallOverExpHistogram / lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram's identical "is not a label-only histogram consumer" guard (histogram_native_label_replace.go).

guard: past exhaustive switch call.Func.Name over [case "info"; case "sort_by_label", "sort_by_label_desc"]
